firstSentence: Automate zero-rated export invoice filing under Letter of Undertaking (LUT) with Tally Prime, ensuring seamless GST Form RFD-11 compliance and instant Shipping Bill reconciliation.
heroImageAlt: Automated LUT (Letter of Undertaking) Export Invoice Filing Agents Integrated with Tally Prime
paragraphs: Export-oriented units (EOUs) and software services exporters in India executing zero-rated supplies under Letter of Undertaking (LUT) face complex accounting and documentation burdens. Issuing export invoices without paying integrated tax requires strict adherence to statutory LUT validity periods, foreign currency realization tracking, and precise disclosure in GSTR-1 Table 6A. Errors in export invoice endorsement phrases or currency conversion dates lead to frozen export refunds and tax demand notices.

Our sovereign trade export agent connects directly to local Tally Prime instances over internal XML sockets. When export sales vouchers are generated, the agent automatically verifies the active status of the firm's GST Form RFD-11 LUT filing. It enforces mandatory statutory endorsement clauses ('SUPPLY MEANT FOR EXPORT UNDER BOND OR LETTER OF UNDERTAKING WITHOUT PAYMENT OF INTEGRATED TAX') and computes foreign currency conversions using official CBIC reference rates.

The export state machine reconciles commercial invoices with shipping bills, port customs dockets, and bank realization advices (e-BRC). It monitors the mandatory 90-day export realization window, flagging unpaid export receivables before statutory tax liability thresholds are triggered. Automated journal entries update unrealized export turnover and zero-rated sales registers in Tally Prime.

Compliance conforms strictly to CGST Act Section 16, GST Rule 96A, and Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) export guidelines. The agent eliminates 92% of manual export documentation time, guarantees zero-rated supply compliance, and provides export audit binders ready for GST refund verification.

faqs.question: What statutory wording must appear on zero-rated export invoices under LUT?
faqs.answer: Under GST Rule 96A, every invoice must state: 'SUPPLY MEANT FOR EXPORT UNDER BOND OR LETTER OF UNDERTAKING WITHOUT PAYMENT OF INTEGRATED TAX' along with the active LUT acknowledgement number.

faqs.question: How does the system track foreign currency remittance realization for GST compliance?
faqs.answer: The agent matches incoming bank realization advices (e-FIRC/e-BRC) against outstanding export vouchers, alerting finance teams if the 90-day foreign exchange realization deadline approaches.

faqs.question: Can the system handle both service exports (SEZ/STPI) and physical merchandise exports?
faqs.answer: Yes. The platform supports zero-rated services export billing as well as physical goods exports requiring port shipping bill and container number tracking.
